entities.summary: Sven Alkalaj (b. 1948-11-11, Sarajevo) was a religious figure or clergy of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Sarajevo and Bosnia and Herzegovina. Known in the fields of bosnia and herzegovina, architects & engineers, europe.
